# Evan Meyerson writes for European Financial Review about the value of legal finance for private equity


December 21, 2025


-
-
-
-


[Evan Meyerson](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/evan-meyerson/) , managing director who leads Burford’s US Commercial team, writes in *European Financial Review* about why private equity firms should consider financing or monetizing legal assets, and how legal finance can unlock liquidity, reduce operating expenses, smooth earnings and enhance exit valuations.


Read the article[here](https://www.europeanfinancialreview.com/the-hidden-value-of-legal-assets-why-private-equity-should-use-legal-finance/) .
